published_applications.title: Le spectre résiduel de GL(n)
published_applications.publication: Annales scientifiques de l’École Normale Supérieure 22 (1989), 605–674
locators: Section I.10, opening paragraph, printed p.639 / PDF index35
Section I.11, opening paragraph, printed p.640 / PDF index36
published_applications.retrieval_status: Primary NUMDAM PDF full text and both exact page views retrieved through web tool.
published_applications.statement_used: Every generic irreducible unitary nonarchimedean GL representation is a normalized product of unitary discrete-series representations twisted by real exponents strictly between -1/2 and 1/2.
dictionary: MW pi=rho; delta_j=our unitary square-integrable delta_j; v_j=t_j.
MW normalized upper-parabolic induction and absolute value agree with BCS.2.
The Whittaker condition in I.11 sets the longer Speh half-length parameters from I.10 to zero.
Every actual E_w has characteristic zero. BCS1 supplies local unitarisability; BCS5 supplies Whittaker genericity.
BCS9 uses original SquareIntegrableSegment and StandardCosocleGL to prove its own finite ordering and cosocle consumer.

a replacement or enlargement of H.litN.aut.bc

retained_foundations.name: H.litN.aut.bc: BaseChangeIsobaricN
retained_foundations.statement: Entire original all-rank definite-inner-form nongeneric package, including actual CsdAsc, all local/spherical/weight clauses.

retained_foundations.name: H.litN.loc.bern: BernsteinUnitaryProductIrreducible
retained_foundations.statement: Normalized two-factor induction of smooth irreducible unitarisable GL factors is irreducible.

retained_foundations.name: H.litN.loc.bz: BernsteinZelevinskyFiniteness
retained_foundations.statement: Only irreducible admissibility and the exact compact-integral normalized-induction contragredient equivalence are used here.

retained_foundations.name: H.litN.loc.sq: SquareIntegrableSegment
retained_foundations.statement: A unitary square-integrable GL representation is the L-segment quotient for a segment.

retained_foundations.name: H.litN.loc.cos: StandardCosocleGL
retained_foundations.statement: An actual ordered list LFactors has an irreducible cosocle with unique maximal kernel.

retained_foundations.name: H.litN.aut.fin: AutomorphicFormsFiniteGL
retained_foundations.statement: Finite-dimensionality at the actual open finite level, compact infinity coefficient type and scalar central character.

retained_foundations.name: H.litN.aut.cusp: CuspFormsBoundedGL clause
retained_foundations.statement: Every cusp function with norm invariant under the split real center is bounded.

retained_foundations.name: Haar quotient measure and finite covolume of GL modulo its split center
retained_foundations.statement: The original adelic GL group is unimodular and its latticeGL quotient has finite Haar volume; Haar uniqueness/fundamental-domain integral transport.

retained_foundations.name: Iwasawa decomposition for original GL block coordinates
retained_foundations.statement: G(F)=P(F)GL(O_F), and the source adelic unipotent/Levi/compact-infinity/finite factorization; the same maps and modulus are used.

retained_foundations.name: Compact adelic additive Fourier uniqueness
retained_foundations.statement: Standard character of A_E/E, nontrivial at each completion; Fourier coefficients detect continuous functions on finite products, and compact Haar/Fubini.

retained_foundations.name: Highest-weight theory for compact U(n)
retained_foundations.statement: Every finite-dimensional continuous irreducible complex U(n) representation is the original dominant-integral highest-weight representation.

retained_foundations.name: Density theorem for simple modules with scalar endomorphisms
retained_foundations.statement: A finite algebraic tensor of simple modules over complex algebras, each having scalar endomorphisms, is simple; coordinate separation of finite tensors.
